### 2026-10-12 – In this session  for Week 2 project i started with making the PCB although the theme is 3D file designing but without a PCB i cant start designing the 3D file for my flipper claw clip

**1.48h**

In this session  for Week 2 project i started with making the PCB although the theme is 3D file designing but without a PCB i cant start designing the 3D file for my flipper claw clip
I started with listing out what exactly I need and checked the connections with simulation ,
and then started drawing my schematic and
i faced one of the problems that is
I need a boost converter whose footprints are not available in EasyEDA
so i downloaded the footprint and symbol for it and imported it in my schematic
and drew the board outline as small as possible
i will start the routing from next session

Hi hackclub members or officials , Here i finalized my design for PCB of flipper and i made as small as possible to make it fit in the CAD as its a hairpin for girls and my goal is to make them feel comfortable and also fashionable
I reduced all the electrical noises by putting ground copper plates on both the layers
made one symbol and footprint of my own of MT3608 to make the 3.7V battery give output of 5V so the MG90s servo gets powered with arduino nano running on it .

### 2026-10-13 – HI hackclub official or anyone else in this session ,

**1.5h**

HI hackclub official or anyone else in this session ,
I started off by making the enclosure and wings  of flipper
First,
I imported my PCB (.step ) file into my fusion 360 software
where i made mi file for flipper , i did it through the online tool of EasyEDA pro and then as i need servo motor(MG90s) specifically for the movements of wing so i imported that CAD file too from grabCAD where i installed the CAD file and imported the upper body , lower body and the Main screw
Then i assembled it and made it as a rigid body .
Just in the base of my imported PCB i made an enclosure sketch which i will extrude on next session with mounting screws

### 2026-10-13 – Hi Hack club officials or reviewers or someone else

**3.17h**

Hi Hack club officials or reviewers or someone else
In this session, my whole Project's layout got changed
When i was going to make the Enclosure of my flipper with the butterfly wings
I noticed something which can be done way better and cheaper , yes but I knew it would hard for me
As i am a beginner , but i love to grow my skills and learn something new Everyday.
I did not hesitate and took the challenge
Seriously after sometime designing the CAD , i realized that Arduino Nano is an Over-kill for a simple Servo moved wings , i shifted to ATtiny85 , it was my first time designing with an IC
I got guide from the Huddle too and it really helped me out
I finished y schematic and Routed the whole board with copper traces and made the board only(38x18)mm making it perfect for girls to be comfortable with an hairclip too
And the best thing in this session is
that I over come my fear and learned something new
and that's the "Best feeling" after all
